# Layout contracts

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m uikit docs` from contracts/*.json - do not edit by hand. -->

What a layout must contain for the kit to drive it. The server can only do two things to a
Panorama layout: write a string into a `{s:...}` text slot, and toggle a class on a panel by id.
So a layout *is* its ids, its text slots and the classes its stylesheet reacts to - everything
else (structure, colours, animation) is yours.

## Rules for every component

- **File**: `panorama/layout/custom_game/<name>.xml`. Plugins refer to it by `<name>` only.
- **Root**: the outermost panel is anonymous (the loader owns it); one level in, a panel with
  `id="<name>_root"` authored with class `hidden`. Text slots are addressed through the root id:
  deriving it from the file name keeps two layouts from sharing their text.
- **Marker**: a comment `<!-- uikit:<component> param=value -->` naming the contract and its pool
  sizes. `python -m uikit check-all` validates every layout that has one.
- **Text**: a slot is `text="{s:<var>}"` on a `<Label>`. Same names in every layout of a component -
  that is what makes a custom toast a drop-in for the bundled one.
- **Style**: `style-<name>` on the component's main panel. Define at least `style-neutral`,
  `style-info`, `style-success`, `style-warn`, `style-danger`.
- **Extra slots**: `Texts["footer"]` on any options record is written to `<prefix>_footer`, and
  `Classes` adds free classes on the main panel - for what a custom layout has and the bundled one
  does not.
- **`empty`**: optional text labels get `empty` when blank; collapse them (`visibility: collapse`).
- **Entry**: `show` is added one network update after `hidden` is removed, so a transition on `show`
  has a start state.

| Contract | What the layout is |
|---|---|
| [abilities](abilities.md) | Per-player ability bar: key, name, cooldown gauge, hold gauge. Tick-friendly. |
| [announce](announce.md) | Centred card (reveal, objective, round intro). A new one plays the exit of the previous first. |
| [banner](banner.md) | One sticky line across the top. A new banner on a visible one rewrites it in place. |
| [killfeed](killfeed.md) | Server-wide feed, newest on top. A pool of rows; entries shift down. |
| [match](match.md) | Compact top bar: a count + title on each side, a timer in the middle, optional score tabs under the sides. Same text for everyone. Tick-friendly. |
| [menu](menu.md) | Menus and sub-menus: entries paginated by the pool size, back button on sub-menus, pager at the bottom. Takes the mouse. |
| [panel](panel.md) | Modal panel: pages in a left menu, stats strip, typed rows with buttons, switches and steppers. Takes the mouse. |
| [roulette](roulette.md) | Case-opening roulette: a strip of cards slows down on a server-drawn winner. Per player. |
| [toast](toast.md) | Stacked, auto-dismissing notifications. A fixed pool of cards per placement. |
| [victory](victory.md) | End of round screen: title, chips, restart countdown. Per player. |
| [vote](vote.md) | Screen of a vote: question, choices with live counts, countdown, clicks. Per player. Takes the mouse. |
